visual.description: Primary white background used across all content sections.
Deep black cinematic hero background with full-bleed photography overlay.
Near-black background used in the footer section.
Primary heading text color used for section titles and product names in uppercase.
Dark gray used for body copy, product descriptions, and footer link text.
White text overlaid on dark hero and editorial image sections.
Black fill used on the solid 'View the Collection' CTA button.
White ghost/outline button style used for secondary CTAs like 'Watch the Show'.
Black used for button outlines and the ghost button border treatment.
Medium gray used for dates and secondary metadata in article/blog listings.
Very light gray background used behind product grid photography.
Very dark near-black used as the sticky navigation bar background.
White text and icon color used in the top navigation bar.
